inspections.finding: The entire initial nun has a continuous narrow column descending from its sloping foot, with only a small enlargement at its bottom. The literal nun qamats in נָקִי and ונאוה has transverse shoulders; the nun hiriq in נתלה is a small rounded terminal; the vav sheva in ונאוה and qof sheva in יבקשו show paired vertical nodes; plain nun in מצאנו stops at the ordinary sloping foot. The target long fused column does not preserve enough subdivisions to distinguish a fused pair or a different obscured point. Retain its vowel disclosure; neither absence nor a particular vowel is certified.

The complete qof has one rounded lower node distinct from the diagonal arm: the arm narrows to a short neck before expanding into a compact rounded dot, with white space around its left, right and lower perimeter. The detached single hiriq beneath qof in נָקִי fixes the size and position; plain qof in same-row צֶדֶק lacks this node. Literal qof tsere in בְּחֻקֵּי and בִּקֵּשׁ has a wider horizontal lower mass, qof segol in קֶדֶם has a broader cluster and lower third-point extension, and qof sheva in יבקשו has two vertical dots. The target preserves a single dot, not those competing structures. Certify U+05B4 after qof at baseline unit scalar112. The point is joined at its upper-left edge; certification uses the entire contour, not expected word form.

The first yod has a definite left-edge inset below the head, followed by a rounded lower-left re-expansion joined to the right stem. The lower node projects left beyond the inset and has a rounded lower boundary separate from the slightly longer right tail. Same-row first yod in חַיֵּיהֶם and yod in ויתנכל show this dagesh-node location and contour. Adjacent second yod in the target, second yod in חַיֵּיהֶם, ordinary yod in נָקִי and heavy ordinary yod in ויבצר have head-to-tail outlines without that lower-left node. Certify U+05BC after the existing yod+hiriq cluster at baseline scalar114, preserving the hiriq and its prior combining order. A white hole is not required; the complete contour distinguishes the literal competitors.
